steps.input:
import re

def extract_grid_after(text, header):
    pos = text.index(header) + len(header)
    lines = text[pos:].splitlines()
    rows=[]
    for line in lines:
        line=line.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r'\d+(?:\s+\d+){29}', line):
            rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
            if len(rows)==30: return rows
        elif rows:
            break
    raise ValueError((header, len(rows)))

demo_pairs=[]
for i in range(1,4):
    txt=user_texts[i]
    inp=extract_grid_after(txt,f'Demo pair {i} input (30x30):')
    out=extract_grid_after(txt,f'Demo pair {i} output (30x30):')
    demo_pairs.append((inp,out))
    trans=[list(row) for row in zip(*inp)]
    print(i, len(inp), out==trans, sum(a!=b for ra,rb in zip(out,trans) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
